versions.changelog:
Initial release of RT-qPCR Primer Designer skill.

- Automates design of RT-qPCR (SYBR Green) primers with integrated thermodynamic evaluation and specificity checking.
- Supports input via NCBI GenBank accession, FASTA sequence, or gene name.
- Retrieves gene annotations, designs primers targeting CDS, and filters by hairpins/self-dimers.
- Provides dual specificity verification (BLAST & transcript off-target scan) with robust offline fallback.
- Outputs a formatted Excel workbook with ranked primer pairs, gene details, and experimental qPCR guidelines.
- Command-line tool supports modular steps (fetch, design, specificity, export-excel) and an all-in-one pipeline mode.
